title: Tree walk
hints: A closure can't easily call itself, so put the recursion in a separate generic function that takes the node and `yield`. It must **return a bool**: `false` means "the loop stopped, unwind everything".

`walk(nil)` returns `true` (nothing to do). Otherwise: walk the left subtree, then `yield(n.key)`, then walk the right subtree, and return `false` the moment any of the three returns `false`. `All` just calls `walk(t.root, yield)`. For `Range`, only go left if `n.key > lo`, only yield if `lo <= n.key && n.key <= hi`, and only go right if `n.key < hi`.
